translations.web: A revelation is within my heart about the disobedience of the wicked: “There is no fear of God before his eyes.”
translations.bsb: An oracle is in my heart regarding the transgression of the wicked man: There is no fear of God before his eyes.
translations.kjv: The transgression of the wicked saith within my heart, that there is no fear of God before his eyes.
translations.asv: The transgression of the wicked saith within my heart, There is no fear of God before his eyes.
